root_cause.summary: TRL DistillationTrainer divided the divergence loss by a zero num_items_in_batch on fully on-policy steps.
root_cause.detail: transformers Trainer._get_num_items_in_batch counts non-ignored labels in the raw pre-generation dataloader batch. On-policy distillation rows are prompt-only at that moment, so the count was 0 for a fully on-policy accumulation window and _reduce_divergence_loss returned jsd_sum/0. logging_nan_inf_filter (default true) replaced the non-finite loss in the log record, so only grad_norm=nan surfaced and the loss appeared finite, which misdirected four prior numerics-focused attempts.
root_cause.fix: DistillationTrainer._fill_buffer now recomputes the count from post-generation buffered labels and stamps it on every micro-slice; compute_loss prefers that value. Mirrors GRPOTrainer, which already computed its own post-generation num_items_in_batch.
root_cause.reproduced_locally: Real DistillationTrainer on an RTX 4090 with Qwen3.5-0.8B LoRA student and Qwen3.5-2B bf16 teacher: pre-fix num_items_in_batch=0, loss inf then nan, 372/372 parameters with non-finite gradients; post-fix stamped count 150 (300 under gradient_accumulation_steps=2), finite loss and grad_norm.
